body:
Ported SHANKPIT's weapon roster with a genuinely new ownership gate PARENA's weapon_mod.prn decides -- a player can only switch to a weapon they've found (real PC_ITEM_WPN_* world pickup) or the universal Knife baseline. item_drop_mod.prn extended so destroying a METAL object drops a real shotgun -- a live, testable spawn path, not just an ungated gate. Real wire-budget regression caught and fixed before landing (current_weapon moved out of the broadcast snapshot into a per-owner-only packet). New tests, server+client both compile clean. commit c0cc3d8.

⚓ ☃
title: Real arsenal weapon-switching gated by found-in-world ownership
